integrity: The all-degree finite-support equivalence is established by a polynomial-zero argument. The exact-arithmetic script checks the three-point separation and Bernoulli examples, not the unrestricted theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only finite-support integer laws are characterized. Infinite-support strongly monotone variables are not covered. Monotonicity of the original untilted characteristic modulus is strictly weaker. Historical originality is assessed with specific residual uncertainty.
title: Finite strong characteristic-function monotonicity characterizes Bernoulli sums
